title: MegaEnderChest
description: LargeEnderChest replaces vanilla Ender Chests with a private multi-page storage system that opens when players use a real Ender Chest block. Built for Paper 1.20.x through 1.21.x, it supports configurable page counts.
body:
## LargeEnderChest

LargeEnderChest is a Paper plugin that upgrades the standard Ender Chest into a powerful multi-page storage system. Instead of being limited to a single inventory, players gain access to up to 5 pages of private storage, all seamlessly integrated into normal gameplay.

When a player opens a real Ender Chest, the vanilla inventory is replaced with a custom GUI that allows navigation between pages while preserving the familiar chest experience.

Admins are handled differently to prevent unintended access. They do not automatically open the custom storage through Ender Chests and must instead use commands to safely access or manage storage.

## Features

• Up to 5 pages of storage  
• Pages can be reduced or limited via configuration  
• Private per-player storage  
• Replaces vanilla Ender Chest interaction  
• Clean GUI with page navigation  
• Persistent data across relogs and restarts  
• Admin-safe access system  
• No NMS or version-specific hacks  
• Built using stable Paper API  

## Commands

`/bigec` Opens your Large Ender Chest  

`/bigec <page>` Opens a specific page  

`/bigec reload` Reloads configuration  

## Permissions

`bigec.use` Allows players to use the Large Ender Chest  

`bigec.reload` Allows reloading the plugin  

`bigec.admin` Allows admin-level access via commands only  

## Admin Behavior

Admins do not trigger the custom Ender Chest when opening a real Ender Chest  

Admins must use commands to access storage  

Prevents accidental interaction or modification  

## Configuration

Default config:
max-pages: 5<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/hV4l7o0lpwc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
intercept-enderchest: true
sounds-enabled: true
